definitions.rawRecords: Array entries in the bundled runtime content sources.
definitions.renderedCardCount: Cards available to the runtime selector before session-size truncation. Composite cards count as one.
definitions.uniqueItems: Distinct normalized card payloads within the stated game or category.
definitions.categoryMemberships: One item-to-category relationship. The same item in two categories counts twice here.
definitions.customItems: Player-authored runtime cards; reported separately and never included in bundled migration totals.
definitions.missingStableIds: Bundled entries without authored persistent IDs. Phase 3 assigns deterministic migration IDs without editing the source arrays.

games.note: Cards are written by players for each round; there is no bundled prompt library to migrate.
